qr.title: QR Analytics
qr.reason: QR scans aren't tracked as a distinct signal yet — they're recorded together with NFC taps under one scan event. A QR-only breakdown would require separating the two, so we report them jointly under NFC Intelligence instead of inventing QR-specific numbers.
qr.requirement: Introduce a dedicated QR scan event type on the tracking endpoint so QR and NFC can be measured independently. This tab will then show QR-specific timelines and placements.

audience.title: Audience Demographics
audience.reason: Demographic signals — language, new vs returning, interests — aren't captured yet. Only anonymous visitor ids and interaction events are recorded, so there is no real demographic data to display.
audience.requirement: Persist visitor language/locale on capture and derive new-vs-returning from the Visitor table, then expose an /analytics/audience aggregation. This tab will populate automatically once those signals are collected.

devices.title: Devices & Technology
devices.reason: Each event already stores the visitor's user-agent, but there is no aggregation endpoint yet — so parsing it into device, OS and browser breakdowns client-side would be guesswork. We'd rather show nothing than fabricated splits.
devices.requirement: Add an /analytics/devices endpoint that parses the stored Event.device user-agent server-side into device class / OS / browser buckets. The real breakdown will render here once that endpoint exists.

geography.title: Geographic Insights
geography.reason: Location-level analytics aren't available yet. The event pipeline has a geo field but does not resolve visitor location on capture, so there is no real geographic data to show — and we won't render fabricated maps.
geography.requirement: Enable IP-to-geo resolution on the tracking endpoint (populate Event.geo), then expose an /analytics/geo aggregation. Country and city breakdowns will appear here once real location data lands.

emptyState: No analytics data available for the selected period.
